title: Program Managers: Deliver Confidently with Faros

hero.headline: Predictable delivery, zero surprises
hero.subhead: Faros delivers the context you need to manage dependencies, optimize capacity, and deliver on time.

sections.heading: Outcomes we deliver — confident delivery without the chaos
sections.body: Confident delivery timelines (spot risks early), optimize capacity planning (historical velocity + actual load), unblock cross-team dependencies, automate status reporting.

sections.heading: How technical program managers use Faros
sections.body: Align engineering effort with strategy (Roadmap vs KTLO vs Unplanned split); eliminate the manual data chase (flag missing story points, stale statuses); drive improvements with objective data (Cycle Time, PR Velocity in retros); monitor sprint health (WIP, focus time, scope changes).

sections.heading: What you get
sections.body: Program Oversight (initiative status/blockers/milestones), Dependency Mapper, Automated Reporting, Data Hygiene Engine (imputes data, prompts owners), Capacity Planner, enterprise-grade security.

notes: Retrieved via Claude-in-Chrome. Role/solution page for TPMs — the audience for the Predictable Delivery / Delivery Excellence capability. Confirms delivery-excellence as a real, distinct product surface (Dependency Mapper, Capacity Planner, Data Hygiene Engine are concrete named features). Reinforces the taxonomy flag: this is PMO/planning, outside the Observe/Optimize/Govern AI-token thesis. Testimonial: Rachna Kamath, Chief of Staff to the CTO, Vimeo.
